subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After this branch is rebased to use current main's `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` gate, should live Matrix/Element send-read proof be required before merge, or is the in-memory Matrix adapter proof enough?
rationale: The repository's external-PR proof policy asks for real behavior proof, but the contributor says they lack Matrix homeserver credentials and the source-path proof is otherwise targeted.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording after the rebase before merge.

options.title: Waive live transport proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the in-memory adapter proof once the duplicate gate is removed and the conflict is resolved.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording after the rebase before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to both historical suppression commits and the original Matrix plugin history, so he is the best available routing owner for the proof waiver question.
